Category: Notebooks & Writing Pads > Spiral Notebooks

## Features
Japanese Notebook: Kokuyo wide ruled notebook is built with a sturdy spiral binding that keeps the pages securely in place for long-term use. The size of every single subject notebook is 10.5” x 8” and come with 80 wide ruled paper sheets. Notebook pack of 3 colors (Purple, Orange, Turquoise); Silky Smooth Writing: Japan imported original Campus papers, developed through extensive research for the most comfortable writing experience with any writing instrument. The paper is ink-fight and feathering for most writing instruments (such as ballpoint pens, gel pens, ballpoint pens, etc.) and ensures a smooth writing experience whether at school or at work.; Wide Ruled: The paper of spiral journal notebook is wide ruled (or medium ruled), paper has 11⁄32 inches (8.7 mm) spacing between horizontal lines. KOKUYO also designed subtle dots for wide ruled lines for precision writing.; Perforated Pages: The perforated pages of these student notebooks make it easy to tear out sheets cleanly and neatly. Whether you need to hand in an assignment or share your notes, the perforations ensure smooth removal. In addition, you can easily transfer the paper to any 3-hole binder because the whole notebook is designed with 3 holes. These are ideal lined notebooks for school and work.; 1 Subject Spiral Notebook: The thick cover material provides good protection, and different colors can easily distinguish different subjects or users. Not only that, the cover reserves enough space to write names and titles. Acid-free paper is pH neutral, which means it's ideal for long-term storage and won't yellow or degrade over time.

Top review: I was looking for some notebooks to start journaling in and boy did I find this great deal and such nice notebooks. This three pack of spiral notebooks is so nice. The covers are so nicely designed and have a puffiness to them. They’re very sturdy some thing you could easily throw in a bag or a purse. I found myself putting one by my computer one by my bed and one next to my chair in the TV room. When I finally did have that breakdown and wanted to journal I found the notebook and the journaling began. It is actually a great thing to do when you’re overwhelmed with anxiety or depression, Just take a journal out and start writing what’s your feeling and it really helps you to sort out what’s going on in your mind and where your problems are coming from. It really truly does help.Or when you do have that breakthrough and you’re thinking of what’s going on write it down so you’re able to tell your therapist or whoever you’re working with and remember it and not say all I can’t remember what I was going through but journaling is great! These journals definitely are nice to have to catch those thoughts and beautiful to have around your house.
